A world, a division of the universe; in general three Lokas are enumerated; viz:--heaven, hell, and earth: another classification enumerates seven, exclusive of the infernal regions; viz:--Bhūr-loka the earth, Bhūvar-loka the space between the earth and the sun, the region of the Munis, Siddhas, &c.; Swar-loka the heaven of INDRA, between the sun and the polar star; Mahar-loka the usual abode of BHRIGU, and others saints, who are supposed to be co-existent with BRAHMĀ: during the conflagration of these lower worlds, the saints ascend to the next, or Jana-loka, which is described as the abode of BRAH-MĀ'S sons, SANAKA, SĀNANDA, SANĀTANA, and SANATKUMĀRA; above this, is the fifth world or the Tapo-loka, where the deities called Vairāgis reside; the seventh world, Satya-loka or Brahma-loka, is the abode of BRAHMĀ, and translation to this world exempts beings from further birth: the three first worlds are destroyed at the end of each Kalpa or day of BRAHMĀ; the three last at the end of his life, or of 100 of his years; the fourth Loka is equally permanent, but is uninhabitable from heat, at the time the three first are burning: another enumeration calls these seven worlds, earth, sky, heaven, middle region, place of births, mansion of the blest, and abode of truth, placing the sons of BRAHMĀ in the sixth division, and stating the fifth or Jana-loka to be that, where animals destroyed in the general conflagration are born again. लोह: लोह mn. (-हः-हं) 	 1. Iron, either crude or wrought. 	 2. Steel. 	 3. Any metal. 	 4. A weapon. 	 5. Aloe-wood or Agallochum. 	 6. Blood. 	 m. (-हः) A red coloured goat. 	 f. (-हा) 	 1. Red, reddish. 	 2. Made of cop-per or iron.  E. लू to cut, aff. ह ।
लोहकण्टक: लोहकण्टक m. (-कः) A thorny shrub.  E. लोह iron, कण्टक a thorn.
लोहकान्त: लोहकान्त n. (-न्तं) The load-stone.  E. लोह iron, कान्त in this compound a gem.
लोहकार: लोहकार m. (-रः) A blacksmith, an ironsmith.  E. लोह iron, कार who works in; also with कन् added लोहकारक m. (-कः) ।
लोहकिट्ट: लोहकिट्ट n. (-ट्टं) Rust of iron, or iron filings.  E. लोह, किट्ट soil or sediment.
लोहचूर्ण: लोहचूर्ण n. (-र्णं) Iron filings.  E. लोह, चूर्ण powder.
लोहज: लोहज n. (-जं) 	 1. Bell-metal. 	 2. Rust of iron, or iron filings.  E. लोह, ज produced.
लोहजाल: लोहजाल n. (-लं) A coat of mail.
लोहजित्: लोहजित् m. (-जित्) The diamond.  E. लोह iron, and जित् conquering, (in hardness.)
लोहदारक: लोहदारक n. (-कं) A hell.  E. लोह and दारक what tears.
लोहद्राविन्: लोहद्राविन् m. (-वी) Borax.  E. लोह metal, and द्राविन् what fuses.
लोहनाल: लोहनाल m. (-लः) An iron arrow.  E. लोह iron, and नाल a stalk.
लोहपृष्ठ: लोहपृष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A heron.  E. लोह iron, पृष्ठ the back.
लोहप्रतिमा: लोहप्रतिमा f. (-मा) 	 1. An image of iron. 	 2. An anvil.  E. लोह iron, प्रतिमा an image.
लोहमय: लोहमय mfn. (-यः-यो-यं) Made of iron.  E. लोह iron, aff. मयट्.
लोहमारक: लोहमारक m. (-कः) A plant (Achyrantnes triandra, Rox.) “शालिञ्चशाके” E. लोह iron, मारक destroying.
लोहराजक: लोहराजक n. (-कं) Silver.  E. लोह metal, राज shining, कन् added.
लोहल: लोहल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Lisping, speaking inarticulately. 	 2. Iron, irony. 	 m. (-लः) The principal ring of a chain.  E. लोह iron, ला to get or be, aff. क ।
लोहवर: लोहवर n. (-रं) Gold.  E. लोह a metal, and वर best.
लोहवर्मन्: लोहवर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Mail, armour.  E. लोह, and वर्म्मन् armour.
लोहवर्म्मन्: लोहवर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Mail, armour.  E. लोह, and वर्म्मन् armour.
लोहशङ्कु: लोहशङ्कु m. (-ङ्कुः) 	 1. A hell. 	 2. An iron pike.  E. लोह, शङ्कु a pike.
लोहश्लेषण: लोहश्लेषण m. (-णः) Borax.  E. लोह metal, श्लिष् to embrace, ल्युट् aff.
लोहाभिसा: लोहाभिसा(हा)र m. (-रः) Lustration of arms, ceremonies performed on the ninth of the light-half of the month Ashwin; formerly a celebration observed by princes before opening a campaign, but now confined to the domestic decoration and worship of the soldier's weapon. E. लोह a weapon, अभि about, सृ to go, or हृ to take, aff. घञ् ।
लोहाभिहार: लोहाभिहार m. (-रः) Lustration of arms.  E. लोह, a weapon, अभि about, हृ to take, aff. घञ्; also लोहाभिसार ।
लोहामिष: लोहामिष n. (-षं) The flesh of a goat with red hair.  E. लोह, आमिष flesh.
लोहिका: लोहिका f. (-का) A sort of large shallow bowl, sometimes of iron, but usually of wood and bound with iron, for the purpose of washing rice, &c.  E. लोह iron, कन् aff., fem. form.
लोहित: लोहित mfn. (-तः-ता or नी-तं) 	 1. Red, of a red colour. 	 2. Made of copper. m. (-तः) 	 1. Red, the colour. 	 2. The planet MARS. 	 3. One of the male rivers. 	 4. The Rohi-fish, (Cyprinus Rohita, HAM.) 	 5. A sort of deer. 6. A snake. 	 7. A deity, a demi-god. 	 8. A sort of bean, (Ervum hirsutum.) 	 9. A form of array. 	 10. A tree, (Andersonia Rohitaka.) n. (-तं) 	 1. Blood. 	 2. A red kind of Agallochum. 	 3. Saffron. 	 4. Red sanders. 	 5. War, battle. 	 6. Copper. 	 7. An imperfect form of a rainbow. 	 f. (-ता) 	 1. A woman red with anger or with colour, &c. 	 2. A sort of creeper, (Lycopodium imbricatum.)  E. रुह् to grow, इतच् Unādi aff., and र changed to ल ।
लोहितक: लोहितक mfn. (-कः-तिका or निका-कं) Red. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. A ruby. 	 2. The planet MARS. 	 n. (-कं) Calx of brass.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
लोहितग्रीव: लोहितग्रीव m. (-वः) An epithet of Agni.
लोहितचन्दन: लोहितचन्दन n. (-नं) Saffron.  E. लोहित red, and चन्दन sandal.
लोलितपुष्पक: लोलितपुष्पक m. (-कः) The pomegranate tree. “दाडिम वृक्षे ।”
लोहितमृत्तिका: लोहितमृत्तिका f. (-का) Red chalk.  E. लोहित red, and मृत्तिका soil, earth.
लोहिताक्ष: लोहिताक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Red-eyed. 	 m. (-क्षः) 	 1. A name of VISHṆU. 	 2. The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. 	 3. A kind of snake.  E. लोहित red, and अक्ष for अक्षि the eye.
लोहिताङ्ग: लोहिताङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The planet MARS.  E. लोहित, अङ्ग body.
लोहितानन: लोहितानन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Red-faced. 	 m. (-नः) An ichneumon.  E. लोहित red, आनन the face.
लोहितायस्: लोहितायस् n. (-यः) Copper.  E. लोहित red, and अयस् iron.
लोहिनी: लोहिनी f. (-नी) A woman red with anger, or painted red. E. See लोहित, the fem. aff. being ङीप्, and the penultimate consonant changed to न ।
लोहोत्तम: लोहोत्तम n. (-मं) Gold.  E. लोह a metal, and उत्तम best.
लौकायतिक: लौकायतिक m. (-कः) An atheist, a materialist, a Bauddha.  E. लोकायत a particular heterodox doctrine, and ठक् aff.; also लोकायतिक ।
लौकिक: लौकिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Mundane, worldly, human, what prevails amongst or is familiar to mankind. 	 f. (-की) 	 1. Common, vulgar. 2. Secular, temporal. 	 3. Customary. 	 n. (-यं) Any usage or general custom.  E. लोक mankind, the world, and ठण् aff.
लौकिकता: लौकिकता f. (-ता) 	 1. Worldliness. 	 2. Worldly currency custom. E. तल् added to the last; also लौकिकत्वं ।
लौक्य: लौक्य mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं) 	 1. Mundane, human. 	 2. Common.  E. लोक and घञ् aff.
लौड्: लौड् r. 1st cl. (लौडति) To be mad or foolish.
लौल्य: लौल्य n. (-ल्य) 	 1. Fickleness, inconstancy. 	 2. Eagerness, passion.
लौह: लौह mfn. (-हः-ही-हं) 	 1. Iron, made of iron, copper, &c. 	 2. Red, copper-coloured. 	 m. (-हः) Iron. 	 f. (-ही) An iron vessel, a pot.  E. लौह iron, and अण् deriv. aff.
लौहबन्ध: लौहबन्ध n. (-न्धं) An iron chain or fetters.  E. लौह and बन्ध binding.
लौहभाण्ड: लौहभाण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A pestle and mortar, usually of metal.  E. लौह and भाण्ड a vessel.
लौहभू: लौहभू f. (-भूः) A sort of iron vessel, a boiler, a caldron.  E. लौह iron, भू being.
लौहात्मन्: लौहात्मन् f. (-त्मा) A sort of iron boiler, a kettle, &c.  E. लौह made of iron, and आत्मन् substance.
लौहिक: लौहिक m. (-कः) The trident of ŚIVA.
लौहित: लौहित m. (-तः) The trident of ŚIVA.  E. लोहित and अण् aff.
लौहितीक: लौहितीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Redish, like or resembling red, &c.  E. लोहित red, and ईकक aff., implying similarity in this compound.
लौहित्य: लौहित्य nf. (-त्य-ती) Redness. 	 m. (-त्यः) 	 1. A male river. 	 2. The ocean. E. लोहित as above, ष्यञ् pleonasm.
ल्पी: ल्पी r. 9th cl. (ल्पिनाति) To unite, to join, to be connected or attached to: it is also read ल्यी-ह्ली-ल्वी, &c.
ल्वी: ल्वी r. 9th cl. (ल्विनाति or ल्वीनाति) 	 1. To go, to move or approach. 	 2. To join or be connected with, to mix with, to unite. 	 3. To obtain: see the last.
